description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hadirawalana, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and owner details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
